_what: Derived time series of codebase health. Each metric is READ from its real source (the ledgers, the mutation baseline, the handbook); this file is never authoritative. Append-only — a snapshot is a reading, not a target.

snapshots.note: first snapshot — develop, immediately after the Track 3 merge. The floor everything after this is measured against.
sample widened to 12 modules; two duplication floors adopted
AdobeAuthStep render helper extracted; webview floor adjudicated

snapshots._note: MIXED ENTRY — read the two halves differently. The duplication metrics are real work: seven wholly redundant test files deleted (44 duplicated tests), which is the -11 clone pairs and -622 duplicated lines. The MUTATION metrics are a MEASUREMENT CORRECTION and must not be counted as progress at program end: jest.pl22.config.js had been naming 12 of installHandler's 13 test suites and 1 of integrationCardModel's 5, so the previous entry's 60.48 was computed over an incomplete test set. No test was written. scoreWeighted 60.48->71.23, noCoverage 232->87 and highValueSurvivors 173->165 are all that one config fix. reports/mutation/baseline.json carries the per-module _supersedes blocks.

Track 4 loop close. The one big move is debt.archExemptions 30 -> 6: the architecture exemption ledger, and every remaining row is ratified or an owner decision. Two categories emptied (constructionBoundary, featureBarrels). The duplication and logger-fake movements here are incidental — a few files deleted along the way — NOT a duplication pass. mutation is unchanged because nothing touched it this run.

PL-13 closed. debt.archExemptions 6 -> 3, and all three are RATIFIED permanent exceptions recorded in ADR-015 rather than debt — so this metric has reached its floor and should not be read as having 3 left to do. It was 30 at the start of 2026-08-31 and 75 when the item was written.

_definitions.dup.src.clones: bash .claude/skills/code-duplication-scan/scan.sh src  (min-lines 8, min-tokens 60, tests ignored) — ratchet 66
_definitions.dup.tests.*: npx jscpd tests --min-lines 20 --min-tokens 140 — ratchet 160 / 2.44%. Jitter is +/-1 between identical runs
_definitions.dup.tests.pairsWebview|pairsService: the same run, split by whether either side of the pair is a .tsx suite
_definitions.mutation.*: READ from reports/mutation/baseline.json, never re-measured here. scoreWeighted is killed/total mutants across pinned modules — NOT a mean of per-module percentages, which would weigh a 40-mutant module equally with a 400-mutant one
_definitions.debt.*: the length of each shrink-only ledger, read from the file that owns it
_definitions.conventions.*: the sentence in docs/development/handbook.md that tests/sop pins

_floors.dup.tests.pairsService: 78 as of 2026-08-31. Duplication BETWEEN files; none is a suite repeating itself. Shared setup wanting one home.
_floors.dup.tests.pairsWebview: 12 as of 2026-08-31. ADJUDICATED, not merely counted: of the three pairs that looked like a suite repeating itself, only AdobeAuthStep was a missing helper (fixed — 15 identical render blocks became one renderStep). ProjectCard and ConfigureScreen-rendering ALREADY use a render helper; jscpd matches those files against themselves at an offset because twenty render-and-assert tests are structurally alike by nature. Those two are a legitimate floor, not debt.
_floors.dup.src.clones: 67 as of 2026-08-31 (the skill says 66; +/-1 is jitter). 7 are JSON config structure, an inert floor.
_floors._why_two: Judged apart because the defect differs. One number let a 2026-08-31 reading describe the whole tree from its five largest clones, which happened to be .tsx and were not representative.
